Tenant Rights in India Regarding Rent Hikes and Eviction

Indian law outlines tenant rights when faced with rent increases or eviction notices. Landlords cannot forcibly remove tenants, seize belongings, or cut essential services like water and electricity if rent is not paid or a property is not vacated. To recover dues or evict a tenant, landlords must pursue legal channels through the courts.
